gloss: plunge pool; basin at the foot of a waterfall

definitions.gloss: plunge pool; basin formed at the base of a waterfall
definitions.explanation: The deep pool of water at the foot of a waterfall, carved out by the long-term impact of falling water. A standard vocabulary item in travel writing about scenic spots and in descriptions of river geography.

examples.japanese: {滝壺|たきつぼ}は{深|ふか}そうだ。
{青|あお}く{澄|す}んだ{滝壺|たきつぼ}に{虹|にじ}がかかっていた。
examples.english: A rainbow hung over the clear blue plunge pool.

examples.japanese: {滝壺|たきつぼ}は{水|みず}の{流|なが}れが{急|きゅう}で{危険|きけん}なので、{絶対|ぜったい}に{入|はい}ってはいけない。
examples.english: The plunge pool has strong currents and is dangerous, so you must never go in.

notes:
Composed of {滝|たき} (waterfall) and {壺|つぼ} (pot, jar, hollow). The {壺|つぼ} element captures the image of a rounded basin carved out of the rock by the falling water. The word is vivid and concrete — a {滝|たき} is the waterfall itself, while the {滝壺|たきつぼ} is specifically the pool it lands in.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}に{落|お}ちる: fall into a plunge pool
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}をのぞき{込|こ}む: peer into the plunge pool
- {深|ふか}い{滝壺|たきつぼ}: a deep plunge pool
- {澄|す}んだ{滝壺|たきつぼ}: a clear plunge pool
- {滝壺|たきつぼ}{巡|めぐ}り: waterfall(-pool) tour

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {滝|たき}: waterfall — the falling water itself, not the pool
- {淵|ふち}: deep pool, depths (of a river) — a deep spot in a river generally, not specifically at a waterfall
- {瀬|せ}: shallows, rapids — the opposite of {淵|ふち}; shallow or fast-flowing water
- {池|いけ}: pond — a standing body of water, usually artificial or natural but not formed by a waterfall
